Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it

141-3905-5256.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.

1365-4853-6009-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-4506.easyPrerequisites:

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5315-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.

Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-3388.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-3388.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-3388.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1594-4200-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1479-5478-5700-5701-7705.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7705.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7705.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the second Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Parallax Tide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve any remaining Emeria Sherpherd triggers.

Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a creature token.
